text:
Based on the onboarding documentation, Ollama Cloud connects via **`https://ollama.com/v1`**, whereas your setup is currently targeting `https://ollama.com/api` (resulting in the `HTTP 404 NotFoundError`).

### How to Fix:
1. Ensure your provider is set to `ollama-cloud` in your configuration (`~/.hermes/config.yaml`).
2. Update your base URL / endpoint to **`https://ollama.com/v1`** instead of `https://ollama.com/api`.
